## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation you are running into. What are you trying to do that termux-sync does not currently support?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the behavior you would like to see. Be as specific as you can about the interface, commands, or configuration options involved.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you found any workarounds or alternative approaches? Why are they insufficient?

## Additional Context

Any other context, references, or examples that would help clarify the request.
